agent.sql_query: WITH top_procedimentos AS ( SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS procedimento, COUNT(*) AS total_geral FROM internacoes i JOIN internacao_procedimento ip ON i."N_AIH" = ip."N_AIH" JOIN procedimentos p ON ip."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" WHERE i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND p."NOME_PROC" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p."NOME_PROC") <> '' AND p."NOME_PROC" NOT IN ('Nao preenchido', 'Nao informado') GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ORDER BY total_geral DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, p."NOME_PROC" AS procedimento, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN internacao_procedimento ip ON i."N_AIH" = ip."N_AIH" JOIN procedimentos p ON ip."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" JOIN top_procedimentos tp ON p."NOME_PROC" = tp.procedimento WHERE i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND p."NOME_PROC" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p."NOME_PROC") <> '' AND p."NOME_PROC" NOT IN ('Nao preenchido', 'Nao informado') GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER"), p."NOME_PROC" ORDER BY ano ASC, MAX(tp.total_geral) DESC;
